thread:
Ashley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete SLO/SLA changes for the inference-v2 incident. Proposing SLO remap + remediation ownership so this doesn't recur.
Maria: Agreed. Recurring pattern was GPU queueing spikes around 10:00–11:00 PST on weekdays, hitting p99 and causing downstream throttles.
Ashley: High-level proposal: tighten latency p99 for inference-v2, and add a throughput SLO for control-plane. Also add a 24h burn-rate alert for error budgets.
Dan: +1. Suggest specifics: inference-v2 p50=40ms, p90=120ms, p99=350ms (previous p99=500ms). Control-plane throughput p95 >= 1200 rps.
Leo: Good call. I'll own dashboards/alerts: update Grafana panels to show rolling 7d p99, 1d burn rate, and request-size distribution.
sre-bot: RFC created: RFC-4521 (SLO remap + remediation). Linked postmortem PM-789.
Maria: I'll take remediation owner. Plan: autoscaler tuning + batch-size cap + capacity reservation for peak window. Target PRs by Wed 2024-06-12.
Ashley: Action items (owners + dates):
  - Maria: remediation runbook + PRs (autoscaler + batch cap + reserve) — due 2024-06-12
  - Leo: dashboard panels & alert rules (p99_7d, burn_rate_24h, request_size_hist) — due 2024-06-10
  - Dan: create synthetic canary and load test for control-plane at 1300rps, add results to RFC — due 2024-06-08
  - Ashley: draft SLA update note for sales/CS and legal review — due 2024-06-15
Dan: Recommend adding an automation to throttle oversized batches when queue depth > 80% to prevent long tails. I'll prototype.
Maria: Quick snippet for the proposed burn-rate alert config we can use in ops repo:
```
slo:
  name: inference-v2-p99
  target: 0.999
  window: 30d
alerts:
  - name: p99_burn_rate
    type: burn_rate
    window: 24h
    threshold: 2.0
```
Leo: I'll add a "requests by batch size" panel to detect shifts that cause queueing. Also add a heatmap for request arrival times to catch the 10–11am burst.
Dan: On the canary: will run a scheduled 15m spike job hitting control-plane at 1300rps and capture latency/queue metrics. If autoscaler doesn't scale within 90s, alert an oncall pager (test only).
Ashley: Also need a short-term mitigation: reserve one extra GPU pool for 09:30–11:30 PST weekdays for 2 weeks while we tune (canary to validate). Maria, please file the infra reservation.
Maria: Filed infra-reserve-231 on the infra side. Added the reservation note in RFC-4521.
sre-bot: Checklist updated on RFC-4521: dashboard, alerts, canary, runbook, infra reservation.
Ashley: Let's reconvene in two weeks for a follow-up retro and to decide whether to roll SLO changes into the public SLA.
oncall_bot: Reminder scheduled: SLO-remediation-checkin on 2024-06-25 10:00 PST (2-week retro).
Leo: I'll attach dashboard links and alert diffs to RFC before EOD Friday.
Dan: I'll post the canary results to RFC once the job runs.
Maria: Will open PRs tomorrow and tag reviewers.
Ashley: Thanks everyone. Please update RFC-4521 status as you complete items. :thumbsup:
